title: Raising A Seed Round With Justin Kan
summary: Raising A Seed Round With Justin Kan
body_markdown:
‍


**Why we love the author:** Justin Kan is an internet entrepreneur, investor, and wonderful public speaker. He co-founded Justin.tv and Twitch, live video platforms as well as a mobile social video app called Socialcam. He has now sold prior companies and now working on his new company, Atrium.


**Twitter handle:** @justinkan


**Website:**[http://justinkan.com/](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Justin_Kan)


**Topics Discussed:**


- Seed Round vs. Series A
- Evolving investment environments
- Seed Stage Pitch Deck
- Intros to Investors
- Keys to closing your seed round


**Why you should listen:**


Figuring out if you are ready for seed-stage funding and what you need to do is a very important step in building a successful start-up. This article helps you determine where you are in the process and what are the best steps to have a great seed round.


**Key Quote:**


“For startups to raise a seed funding round, you don’t have to have everything figured out yet…”


‍
